title: Railway RRB Assistant Loco Pilot ALP CEN.No. 01/2025 CBT-I Result/ Cutoff/ Score Card 2026 Out for 10970 Post
intro: RRB Railway has Officially Released CBT-I Result/ Cutoff/ Score Card for the Post Of Assistant Loco Pilot ALP CEN . No.01/2025 Recruitment 2025 for 10970 Post. Exam Held On February 13, 16, 17 & 18, 2026 & CBT-I Result/ Cutoff Available On June 12, 2026.  . All Interested Candidates Can Download CBT-I Result/ Cutoff/ Score Card Now in The Given Link Below.
importantDates: CBT Exam City : 04 Days Before Exam Date
Result/ Score Card Declared On: 12 June 2026
Age Relaxation Extra as Per Rules.
Important Instruction for the All Candidates Expect the Fee Concession Categories.
Candidates Must be Enter the Your Account Number, Account Holder Name, IFSC Code Under Login Section.
Railway Will be Refunded General/ OBC/ EWS Candidates Rs. 400 & SC / ST Candidates Rs. 250/-
After the Appear the First Stage CBT Examination Your Exceed Amount Will be Refunded at Your Bank.
Note : If you have Not Appeared in CBT Exam Amount Not be Refunded.
